definitions.short: Ram , the name of an Arabian and of an Israelite
definitions.full: H7410. Ram רָם proper name, masculine 1. a. an ancestor of David , Ruth 4:19 (twice in verse), brother of Jerachmeel 1Chr 2:9-10 ,. b. son of J. 1Chr 2:25 , 27 . — Αρραν , Ραμ , etc. 2 name of Elihu's family , Job 32:2 ( Ραμ[α], Αραμ ), dubious, compare Bu.

occurrences.englishText: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,
and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,
The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
